articles.summary: Nantucket's conservation Land Bank bought four properties for $5.45 million, including three adjoining Hinsdale Road parcels for $2.75 million.
articles.why_it_matters: A municipal conservation land bank buying open space is unrelated to Domain's builder lot-financing business.

articles.summary: Martha's Vineyard Land Bank registrar's report listing transfer-fee collections for early November 2026.
articles.why_it_matters: A conservation land bank's fee report has no bearing on builder land financing or Domain's competitors.

articles.summary: TV segment on the Detroit Land Bank Authority's programs for residents to buy city-held homes and lots.
articles.why_it_matters: A city land bank authority selling vacant property to residents is not Domain's business and involves no builder.

articles.summary: Video version of WXYZ's report that Detroit is reforming its land bank and releasing 7,500 held properties for sale.
articles.why_it_matters: Syndicated copy of a municipal land bank story with no builder or land-finance angle for Domain.

articles.summary: Detroit Mayor Sheffield announced land bank reforms, including releasing holds on 7,500 properties and lots for purchase.
articles.why_it_matters: Duplicate of the Detroit municipal land bank story; scattered urban parcels for residents are not builder lot supply Domain finances.

articles.summary: A Nantucket waterfront estate sold for a record $42.5 million, with $850,000 going to the island's Land Bank via the transfer fee.
articles.why_it_matters: A luxury home sale funding a conservation land bank has nothing to do with Domain's builder customers or competitors.

articles.summary: Detroit Mayor Mary Sheffield said the city will release 7,500 Detroit Land Bank Authority properties previously held from sale.
articles.why_it_matters: A city land bank authority releasing vacant parcels to residents is not a source or competitor for Domain's builder lot financing.

articles.summary: Detroit Mayor Sheffield's land bank reform plan adds buyer protections such as property tours and renovation support.
articles.why_it_matters: Another angle on the Detroit municipal land bank reforms, with no builder or land-finance relevance to Domain.

articles.summary: South Africa's Land Bank (an agricultural development lender) opened applications for its 2027 tuition bursary.
articles.why_it_matters: A foreign agricultural bank's student bursary is unrelated to Domain.

articles.summary: West Bengal is promoting the Asansol-Durgapur region as the focus of its industrial land bank under a new industrial policy.
articles.why_it_matters: An Indian state's industrial land policy has no connection to US builder land financing.

articles.summary: The Kingston City Land Bank in New York proposed its first multi-family project, a 10-unit townhome development in Midtown.
articles.why_it_matters: A city land bank building 10 townhomes is municipal housing activity, not a builder or land-finance story for Domain.

articles.summary: Ohio's Muskingum County Land Reutilization Corporation reviewed its 12 ongoing projects at its monthly meeting.
articles.why_it_matters: A county land bank's meeting update is unrelated to Domain's builder customers or competitors.

articles.summary: Northern Ireland listed buildings are said to be at risk from speculative land banking and high-value drinks licences.
articles.why_it_matters: UK heritage-property speculation uses the term land banking but has no link to US builder lot financing.

articles.summary: Colorado gave $2.5 million in Proposition 123 land banking funds to an affordable housing development in Pueblo.
articles.why_it_matters: State affordable-housing land grants are public funding, not competing capital for Domain's builder customers.

articles.summary: Australia's tax office fined a foreign investor about A$370,000 in its crackdown on foreign land banking.
articles.why_it_matters: Australian foreign-investment enforcement is irrelevant to US builder land financing.

articles.summary: New Zealand party Te Pati Maori proposed five new taxes, including a land banking tax, ahead of the 2026 election.
articles.why_it_matters: Overseas election tax policy has no bearing on Domain.

articles.summary: Anarock data show Indian real estate developers' land acquisition fell 56% year on year to 1,445 acres in January to September.
articles.why_it_matters: Indian developer land buying says nothing about US builders' land appetite or demand for Domain's capital.

articles.summary: Burundi and the African Development Bank launched a project to develop 1,735 hectares of irrigated farmland.
articles.why_it_matters: An African agricultural development project is unrelated to Domain.

articles.summary: The World Bank approved an additional $500 million for Nigeria to address flooding and restore degraded farmland.
articles.why_it_matters: Development-bank flood financing in Nigeria has no connection to Domain's business.

articles.summary: Second report of the World Bank's $500 million Nigeria flooding and land-restoration financing.
articles.why_it_matters: Duplicate of an off-topic development-finance story with no relevance to Domain.
